finding_text: Refrigerator R-12 temperature logs in the Laboratory department had missing entries for the evening shift on three consecutive days.
notes: No causal claim at all -- only the deviation is described.

finding_text: During the internal audit on 12 May, refrigerator R-12 temperature logs in the Laboratory department were reviewed and found missing entries for the evening shift on three consecutive days; staff confirmed they had not been retrained after SOP-LAB-001 was revised last month.
notes: Self-reported single cause: staff admission of a training gap, no corroborating record cited.

finding_text: Equipment calibration for pipette P-19 was found overdue. Staff initially said the calibration was overdue due to workload pressure that week, but later said the technician had simply forgotten to log the request -- the two explanations were not reconciled during the audit.
notes: Self-reported conflicting causes from staff -- still an attributed claim (or claims), not corroborated by any record; conflict should lower confidence but not collapse the status to NOT_ESTABLISHED.

finding_text: Calibration certificate log shows the pipette P-19 calibration lapsed on 3 March, and the equipment maintenance register confirms no calibration request was ever logged despite the automated reminder system flagging it that week.
notes: Corroborated cause -- two specific records (calibration certificate log, equipment maintenance register) are cited as confirming the cause, not just claimed.

finding_text: Reagent lot LOT-4410 was used past its expiry date; the reagent had been stored in the general supply area rather than the designated cold-chain refrigerator for an unknown period before use.
notes: Implied-but-unstated cause -- improper storage is suggested by context but no one is quoted or described as attributing the expiry/misuse to it; no attributed_statement exists.

finding_text: sop not followd. no evidence smh
notes: Garbled/short text -- observation quality should be flagged INSUFFICIENT and no causal claim is extractable.

finding_text: Equipment was not functioning correctly during the inspection; no further details were recorded at the time.
notes: No department given (blank field) and no causal claim -- tests the pipeline handles a missing department gracefully.

finding_text: For the third time this month, autoclave AC-01 failed to reach sterilization temperature; staff noted this has previously been attributed to a faulty door seal that was never replaced after the last service visit.
notes: Multi-day/recurring issue with a self-reported cause (faulty door seal) attributed to staff, no corroborating maintenance record cited.

finding_text: Centrifuge C-04 stopped mid-cycle during a single run on 14 June; no error code was displayed on the unit and the issue did not recur on subsequent runs that day.
notes: Single one-off equipment failure with no causal claim from anyone -- just a description of what happened.

finding_text: QC on the Cobas c311 flagged a Westgard 1-3s violation on the Level 2 control for ALT; the biomedical scientist on duty said the reagent lot might be the culprit but did not check the certificate of analysis before the shift ended.
notes: Mixed English/technical jargon (Westgard rules, QC, CoA) with a hedged but specific attributed claim (reagent lot) and explicitly no corroborating record checked.

finding_text: New hire J. Rahman completed onboarding, but the training coordinator confirmed the competency assessment checklist was never signed off due to a scheduling conflict with the assessor.
notes: HR/training scenario -- training coordinator's attributed statement names a specific cause (scheduling conflict), no record cited confirming it.

finding_text: Preventive maintenance ticket FAC-2291 for the HVAC unit in the sample storage room was closed without any supporting evidence attached to the ticket.
notes: Facilities finding with no causal claim -- just describes a process gap (ticket closed without evidence).

finding_text: A dispensing error was identified where the pharmacist confirmed she had misread a similarly-packaged medication label, which she attributed to poor lighting at the dispensing counter that has been an issue for weeks.
notes: Pharmacy dispensing error with a specific self-reported environmental cause (poor lighting), no corroborating record (e.g. facilities log) cited.

finding_text: Nursing shift handover notes for Ward 3 were incomplete for two consecutive shifts; the ward manager stated this was due to the ward being short-staffed that particular week.
notes: Nursing documentation gap with a self-reported staffing/workload cause attributed to the ward manager, uncorroborated by a roster or staffing record.

finding_text: Document control review found SOP-QA-004 still referenced the previous revision number on its header despite the content being updated; the document control log confirms the header-update step was skipped during the last revision cycle.
notes: Corroborated cause -- the document control log is cited as confirming the specific process step that was skipped.

finding_text: Internal audit against ISO 15189 clause 5.6 found that the measurement uncertainty budget for the glucose assay had not been reviewed in over 24 months; no reason was given for the lapse.
notes: Standard/clause-referenced finding with no causal claim -- explicitly states no reason was given.

finding_text: It was not done correctly and nobody seems to know why; the supervisor said they would look into it and get back to the team.
notes: Ambiguous/vague finding with a quoted supervisor statement that defers investigation rather than naming a cause -- tests that a non-causal quote isn't misclassified as SELF_REPORTED.

finding_text: Incoming inspection rejected reagent shipment LOT-6633; the supplier's certificate of analysis was reviewed and found to show out-of-range values for the calibrator lot, confirming a supplier quality issue.
notes: Corroborated supplier/material cause -- the certificate of analysis was reviewed and is cited as confirming the out-of-range values.

finding_text: A batch of finished product was shipped to the client before the pharmacist's release-check log was reviewed; the log confirms the required secondary check was never performed for that batch.
notes: Corroborated cause WITH external impact explicitly stated (shipped to client) -- regression guard that recall/customer-notification language is ALLOWED to appear here since external impact is genuinely described, unlike F-020.

finding_text: Internal QC review found that control material Lot QC-2291 was used past its stability date; the QC logbook confirms the expiry check step was skipped by the technician on duty. No results were released and no samples left the laboratory.
notes: Corroborated cause, explicitly INTERNAL ONLY (no results released, no samples left the lab) -- regression guard for 3.2.1: recall/quarantine/customer-notify language must NOT appear despite this being a product-quality-adjacent finding.

finding_text: The Cobas c311 analyzer was mentioned during the walkthrough.
notes: Thin finding dressed up to look rich -- names a specific system but describes no actual gap, deviation, or causal claim; guards against the pipeline inventing a finding/cause just because a specific system name is present in the text.

finding_text: During a routine walkthrough of the sample receipt area, the receiving clerk mentioned that the barcode scanner had been intermittently misreading labels for about a week, which she believed was why several samples were manually logged instead of scanned.
notes: General LQMS variety -- equipment malfunction self-reported by staff (clerk's belief about the scanner) with a timeframe, no corroborating maintenance/IT log cited.
